name: Fitness app
summary: A fitness app on a phone: today's three goals as rings with the true numbers beside them, a week of exercise in one glance (one hue, today in the highlight), a streak, a workout in progress on a dark screen with a huge timer and one Pause button, and the history by week with a summary and splits. From 768px a sidebar and two panes. Onboarding, loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Welcome (drawing, one sentence, Set my goals) → Today: rings and their numbers, the week as bars, the streak, three workouts to pick up, Start a run low → Workout: phase, the timer huge, intervals as a row of bars, three figures, End and Pause → History: the month as one figure, workouts by week → Summary: distance large, three figures, splits → Goals: grouped settings
type: geometric: round, open letters that read at arm's length while moving
motion: No scroll moments. The rings fill once when today opens; the timer counts; a pushed screen slides in.
